scientific_question: Can the dormant 984321-param OrthoLocalizer+retrieval sidecar, trained with BindingLayout on the T3 disjoint corpus while the Phase1G base is frozen, produce held-out native forced-choice and assignment reversals without language regression?

parent.lineage: Phase1G U6000; not a T3 descendant

objective.native: T2 length-normalized hardest-distractor margin M=1.0 on logits from model.forward(layout=BindingLayout)
objective.localization: CE on mean localizer logits over the two slots vs correct candidate index, lambda_loc=1.0
objective.no_t3_pointer_on_base: base pointer term is not trained; base frozen

layout.key_positions: first token of each candidate mention_span_bos
layout.value_positions: last token of each candidate mention_span_bos

corpus: T3 rebuilt train/DEV/ACQ16 only; T3 TEST never loaded

schedule.language_sgd: none; base frozen so CE is a preservation probe only

gates.language: DEV CE within 1e-3 of U0 (1.204); hard stop if > 1.30

test_policy: T3 TEST remains SEALED_UNOPENED. T4 has no separate TEST panel in this freeze.
